category_rubric: billing = charges, invoices, prices, plans, seats, refunds, payment methods; bug = something in the product behaves incorrectly; feature_request = asks for a capability the product does not have; account = login, passwords, users, roles, ownership, security, data deletion, compliance documents; other = sales, partnerships or anything else. A 'how do I...' question about existing functionality belongs to the area it is about (e.g. adding a user = account), not feature_request.
sentiment_rubric: angry = hostile or threatening language, ALL CAPS, ultimatums, words like unacceptable; frustrated = annoyed or under pressure but civil; neutral = matter-of-fact; positive = thanks or enthusiasm. Urgency alone is not anger.
priority_rubric: P1 = service down or broken for many users, security incident, money taken wrongly, or an angry customer who has already chased; P2 = something broken for one user/team with impact, account access problems, billing questions that need action; P3 = how-to questions, feature requests, minor cosmetic issues.
